objective: Polish existing Yoctui screens with consistent focus, hierarchy, navigation feedback and honest loading states, without replacing GitUI or changing daemon ownership.
reference_is_not_a_baseline: At execution, record the actual branch, HEAD, dirty paths, binary identity and relevant existing tests. Reuse completed behavior; do not assume this revision remains current.

included: Build Environment path forms and discovery feedback
Consistent existing browser navigation and scrolling feedback
Existing Dashboard and Performance telemetry presentation
excluded: Copying third-party source, themes, icons or artwork
New daemon transports, build schedulers or metadata sources
New editors, PDF or schematic engines
New telemetry collection or history pipelines
Changing existing shortcuts or requiring uppercase-letter shortcuts
Unrelated bugs, full image builds, QEMU/kernel debugging validation
Publishing, pushing, installing binaries or restarting user services without a separate instruction

invariants: The TUI owns presentation; the daemon owns persistent work; BitBake owns metadata and outcomes.
Preserve user configuration, active builds, PTYs, writer ownership, review/confirmation and detach behavior.
Retain GitUI and the current embedded-terminal architecture.
Reuse existing typed state, command catalog, widgets, themes and test harnesses; do not introduce a second state authority.
Do not create or modify AGENTS.md or additional task-control documents.
Any commits must use Roy Cohen <roy@0xbadcaffe.dev> as author and committer.

dependency_policy.default: Use existing dependencies; zero new dependencies is the acceptance target.
dependency_policy.if_a_dependency_is_needed: Admit only if needed for a named acceptance check and all license/package checks pass within the existing milestone attempt and time budget; otherwise defer the proposal outside this scope.
dependency_policy.allowed_integration: Black-box API usage only; do not copy or port implementation code into Yoctui.
license_requirements: Check the exact pinned release and applicable transitive licenses.
Retain original license text, copyrights and required notices under licenses/.
Include applicable licenses/ files in affected published crates and binary distribution archives; verify archive contents.
Do not overwrite or remove existing compliance notices.
dependency_policy.verification: If no dependency is added, compare Cargo manifests and lockfile dependency graph with the execution baseline; only coherent internal version changes are allowed.

execution_limits.limit_includes: Implementation, compilation, validation, prerequisite work and waiting during this execution; it is a hard ceiling, not a target.
execution_limits.same_test_after_fix: Run again only after a relevant change, or the single documented infrastructure retry. Count it against the milestone attempt limit.
execution_limits.cargo_environment_applies_to: Every Cargo invocation, including commands started by scripts.
prohibited_loops: Repeated full test suites without a relevant change
Repeated visual redesign after acceptance criteria pass
Automatically increasing timeouts or performance thresholds until a test passes
Updating snapshots merely to hide unexpected differences
Repeated prerequisite installation or CI retries without new evidence

state_machine.success: Every required milestone passed, every required check has evidence from the final applicable revision, and no introduced defect is open.
state_machine.blocked: Name the exact missing prerequisite or unresolved dependency. Never count blocked or untested work as passed.
state_machine.stop: On budget/attempt exhaustion, stop the affected milestone. Continue independent work only if its prerequisites passed and the overall budget remains. End the execution when no eligible work remains.
state_machine.reopening_passed_work: Only for a reproducible regression caused by a later scoped change. Record the failing check and charge repair to the responsible later milestone; do not restart the whole plan.
state_machine.scope_changes: Require a separate user instruction; do not silently expand this document.

record: Test commands, relevant environment, exit codes and duration
Named acceptance checks with pass/fail/blocked results
Current-frame text/cell captures and before/after rasters for changed layouts
Actual attempt counts, remaining budget and terminal stop reason
evidence.rule: Keep transient evidence under ignored artifacts/. A successful command that selected zero tests does not satisfy a test requirement.

rules: Use the existing TestBackend and PTY harnesses; inject clocks and measurements for cell assertions.
Assert the current composed terminal frame after each action; do not search accumulated ANSI history.
Use bounded polling with fixed deadlines, not long fixed sleeps.
Check selection, viewport and mouse geometry against the same model state.
Every acceptance test must fail against the relevant broken behavior or demonstrate an explicit contract.
Existing tests satisfying a check are reused, with their exact test names recorded.
Live performance measurements are observations unless an existing repository threshold applies.
Never manufacture build percentages, task totals, PSI values or loading stages.

milestones.title: Baseline and reuse audit
deliverables: Record the actual revision, branch, binary, dirty tree, relevant tests and available tools.
Map each acceptance check to existing behavior or one concrete gap. Freeze the selected layouts before implementation.

acceptance_checks.assertion: No existing user changes are lost or included in commits accidentally.
Every later check is classified existing-pass, demonstrated-gap or prerequisite-blocked.
Capture Dashboard, Tasks, Build Environment, Layers, Recipes, Images and Terminal Sessions before changes.
Record existing documented performance thresholds and the host used for comparisons.

verification: Read docs/interface-behavior.md, docs/widgets-and-dependencies.md, docs/testing.md and relevant source.
Run the existing focused UI/PTY checks once for affected behavior. Do not run a baseline full workspace suite.
Run scripts/verify-performance-ci-fast.sh once and retain its existing thresholds and evidence for final comparison.

milestones.title: Focus and semantic colors
deliverables: Use one shared style mapping for focus, inactive borders, selection, muted metadata and status.
Retain existing themes and accessibility fallbacks.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Exactly one active input owner has the focus treatment in each tested layout.
An inactive pane may retain its selection without looking focused.
Success, attention and failure retain readable text or symbols with color disabled.
Tab and Shift+Tab visit only visible panes; modal input stays trapped.
No changed screen loses a keyboard action or a mouse hit target.

verification: Add or reuse ui_polish_focus and ui_polish_colors tests under existing crate test folders.
Exercise the three sizes and four render modes with fixed fixtures.

milestones.title: Header and contextual footer
deliverables: Prioritize project, MACHINE, target and daemon connection in the header.
Keep detailed Git/backend information accessible in existing details/help.
Show at most six immediate footer actions plus an existing Help/Menu entry; prefix mode expands its own commands.

acceptance_checks.assertion: At 80x24, important values use explicit truncation and never overlap or split a grapheme.
Full truncated values remain accessible through an existing detail/help surface.
Footer actions match current focus and ownership; disabled actions explain their reason.
Terminal footer distinguishes Yoctui controls, terminal writer input and read-only state using words.
Existing key bindings remain unchanged, including Ctrl+B and writer release.

verification: Add or reuse ui_polish_header and ui_polish_footer TestBackend tests.
Use PTY assertions for navigator, modal, terminal viewer and terminal writer contexts.

milestones.title: Honest connection and loading presentation
deliverables: Present only stages supported by existing events: path validation, initialization, daemon connection and metadata loading.
Distinguish daemon connection from recipe inventory readiness.

acceptance_checks.assertion: A responsive daemon with metadata pending is labeled connected/loading, not metadata ready.
Unknown totals produce no invented percentage; empty and loading states differ.
Partial results stay usable and cannot reset selection as more results arrive.
Failure shows the actual reason and an applicable retry/edit action.
Navigation and cancel remain responsive while a delayed fixture scan is pending.
Stale results from a previous generation cannot change the current workspace.

verification: Use delayed, partial, failed and stale-result fixtures; no live build required.
Add or reuse ui_polish_loading tests and extend the existing environment reconnect PTY test only for uncovered cases.

milestones.title: Environment path form polish
deliverables: Give Source, Build and Script consistent labels, browse affordances and discovery feedback.
Reuse existing initializer discovery and reviewed connection flow; add only missing presentation or routing.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Typed paths, bracketed paste and paths containing spaces preserve the exact accepted value.
Script browsing lists files and folders; Enter chooses a file or enters a folder; Esc preserves the previous draft.
Source-folder selection detects an existing initializer; no match shows an actionable explanation and preserves manual editing.
Relative paths, missing source/script, source pointing to a file and unreadable entries identify the affected path.
A missing build directory with an existing writable parent remains valid for reviewed creation.
Discovery, browsing and review never source the initializer; only confirmation initializes.
Failed initialization preserves the preceding daemon and user configuration.

verification: Reuse scripts/test-environment-setup.py and scripts/test-environment-reconnect-pty.py; extend assertions only for demonstrated gaps.
Test actual Ctrl+V if a desktop clipboard is available, restoring its prior content; otherwise report that live check blocked and retain bracketed-paste coverage.

milestones.title: Browser and scrolling consistency
deliverables: Apply shared breadcrumb, selection, position and scroll presentation to existing Layers, rootfs Files, Build Directory and Workbench file views.
Preserve each view's established filesystem authority and actions.

acceptance_checks.assertion: For 200 filtered rows, position text matches the visible range and the filtered count.
Home, End, PageUp, PageDown and wheel reach the final row and can move upward again.
Scrollbar thumb position is monotonic during downward navigation and reaches the bottom at the final viewport.
Returning from a file preview restores the same selection and viewport.
Selection survives resize and background refresh when the selected stable identity still exists.
Empty and single-row collections have correct counts and no division-by-zero or invalid selection.

verification: Add or reuse ui_polish_scroll tests with fixed 200-row trees/lists.
Exercise each of the four named browsers at all three sizes; test mouse hit geometry after resize.

milestones.title: Existing telemetry readability
deliverables: Refine existing CPU, memory, disk and pressure readings in Dashboard and Performance.
Use existing history only where already available; defer new history collection outside this scope.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Every displayed meter retains a numeric value and unit, or explicit unavailable state.
Zero is distinct from unavailable; values outside expected bounds do not break layout.
Pressure/warning colors use existing configured thresholds and textual labels.
Compact layouts retain the measurements already guaranteed by current tests.
No new per-frame filesystem/network probes, unbounded history or background sampler is introduced.

verification: Reuse compact-resource-meter tests and add ui_polish_telemetry fixture cases for zero, unknown, normal and high pressure.
Inspect render paths and dependency diff; record whether existing history was available.

milestones.title: Final acceptance and stop
deliverables: Validate the fixed scope, update only intentionally changed golden references and relevant user help.
Produce the final result inventory and stop; do not start another polish cycle.

acceptance_checks.assertion: All named milestone checks pass at the final applicable revision; any blocked required check prevents complete status.
GitUI still opens in the embedded terminal and receives input only with writer ownership.
Terminal detach/reconnect, search, resize and clean exit retain their existing contracts.
Every changed golden has an explained intentional difference; tests also pass with golden-update variables unset.
Existing performance gates pass without relaxed thresholds or added sampling/render work.
No third-party code/assets were copied; any admitted dependency has license/notice files under licenses/ and verified package inclusion.
No introduced regression remains open and no release/push/install occurred without separate authorization.

verification: Run focused regression tests and scripts/test-tui-snapshots.sh, scripts/test-tui-keymap.sh and scripts/test-tui-flow.sh where applicable.
Run cargo fmt --all --check; cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings.
Run cargo test --locked --workspace --all-features once; permit one repair run only for a concrete relevant failure.
Run scripts/check-library-layout.py, scripts/check-version-bump.py against the recorded execution baseline, and relevant documentation/golden/raster checks.
Run scripts/verify-performance-ci-fast.sh once at acceptance and compare with M0; permit one diagnostic rerun, within the global three-run cap.
Record real GitUI/session smoke results separately from fixture coverage. Missing prerequisites are blocked, never passes.

required: Remaining failures, missing prerequisites and pre-existing failures
Attempt/budget consumption and terminal stop reason
One next practical milestone, or explicitly none for this scope
completion_report.complete_means: M0 through M7 all passed. A polished screenshot alone is not acceptance.

development_build_tool.integration: External executable only; no RUSTC_WRAPPER, Cargo override or runtime dependency.
development_build_tool.deferred_reason: User requested putting Blaze on hold for later; it is not an acceptance prerequisite or blocker.
development_build_tool.previous_probe_limitation: Release requires toolchain manifest 187c11dc57908faed50beacf02d982fbd188ecb17f2e0c8b5c7571b4393d5793; archive omits it and the pinned blaze-toolchain helper is an empty main(). The released CLI also has no build/export command.
development_build_tool.active_build_tool: Cargo, using the existing two-job/resource settings and repository toolchain.
development_build_tool.resume_policy: Revisit Blaze only when the user asks; no installation attempts or compatibility probes during UI polish.
